correctness.rationale: Nonempty self-inverse partial maps have equal affine domain and image. On each domain the map is I+N with translation b, with N²=0 and Nb=0. The image–kernel flag and induced isomorphism give T(k,r) without multiplicity; solvability of Nx=b gives exactly 2^r admissible translations with fixed points. Including the empty map and taking the rank variable as domain cardinality gives the polynomial. An independent pointwise enumeration through internal dimension 4 matched every stratum; at k=4 the strata by fixed-point count 0, 4, 8, 16 were 645, 840, 210, 1. The normalized affine-involution weights are a_s P_k/P_r at s=k−2r. The Euler product F(u) has F(−1)=0, F(1/2)=F/2 and F(−1/2)=P∞, giving the parity split. Summable domination of a_c P_d/P_{d−c} h_{d−c} gives the codimension law and total constant. Taking even and odd d subsequences separately, the two limits of the fixed-point-free fraction both equal one-half, since the limiting even/odd codimension masses are equal. The independent branch did not execute the frozen verify.py; enumeration is corroboration, not a proof of the limits.
